$Comment: Health the carrier regains each second, as a percent of their maximum Health (0.5 is half a percent a second). Any item's StatModifiers raise it like any stat, and so does an effect's RawStatModifiers, such as a meal. ziggfreed-common's regen pass pays it to a living player every tick, and pauses it for 15 seconds after any hit they take, so it heals between fights rather than during one. Base 0; a total at or below 0 regains nothing.
